title: Bali Street Feast
style: World-pop family anthem with tropical percussion, syncopated hand drums, ukulele plucks, and bright chant rhythms; verse spotlights each singer in turn, pre-chorus stacks call-and-response and playful language swaps, chorus hits with gang vocals and clapped accents. Layered family harmonies, ad-lib echoes, whistle lifts, and a clean punchy mix with sunlit low end., happy, comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey happy, smart core
Dunedin kiwi, moving sure
Michelle on the court, all game
Mishy Mish Mash, call the name

Ruby in the color trail
Girl kid style, never pale
Art stays with me, hold that flame
Roo roo, say my name

[Pre-Chorus]
Platt your hair, let it sway
Local flavours lead the way
Bali street food, belly full
Every lane got something cool

[Chorus]
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Bali on my plate today
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Local flavours everywhere

Ruby, Wesley, can you swim?
We can learn it quick, jump in
Da da, I got this, watch me
Watch Wezza go, comedy

[Verse 2]
Wesley gamer pro, no fear
Wez, Wezza, bringing cheer
English, español, switch and spin
Laugh so hard, we all lean in

Corey takes the stage tonight
My turn now, keep it light
Mishy calls, “Come play with me”
Family groove, we run free

[Pre-Chorus]
Sun on skin and salt on bread
Big bright grin, enough said
Local flavours, hands held high
Sing with me, we touch the sky

[Chorus]
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Bali on my plate today
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Local flavours everywhere

Ruby, Wesley, can you swim?
We can learn it quick, jump in
Da da, I got this, watch me
Watch Wezza go, comedy

[Bridge]
Corey, Mishy, Ruby, Wez
All our voices in the mix
Back and forth, we trade the lines
Four small stars in family time

Platt your hair, then shout it back
One big table, one big pack
Bali friends, sing with me
All suno instruments show case per culture

[Final Chorus]
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Bali on my plate today
Dollar dollar dollar, hey
Local flavours everywhere

Ruby, Wesley, can you swim?
We can learn it quick, jump in
Da da, I got this, watch me
Corey takes the stage with me
